<cite ref="Yevamot 38b:17">Yeb. 38ᵇ</cite> (the law is easy in the case of a woman’s widowhood) <he>משום ח׳</he> in order to make her attractive (v. <cite ref="H01249">preced.</cite>); [oth. opin.: in order that women may be willing to marry; oth. opin.: in order to maintain pleasantness between husband and wife;] <cite ref="Ketubot 84a:16">Keth. 84ᵃ</cite>; a. e.
